evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing without asking about specific concerns like on-time reliability or damage protection.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were raised by the customer, so no follow-up depth was possible.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep quoted a fixed date (October 19th) without discussing whether cheaper days existed or asking about date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked. Rep provided estimate ($1,617) and said 'I'll go ahead and send you an email for the quote after this call and will there be anything else?' — no rate lock mentioned, no deposit confirmation, no explicit ask for the business.

top_strength: Jevic gathered sufficient logistics details (apartment size, floor, walk distance, furniture inventory, storage location) to produce a reasonable estimate and clearly explained the pricing model, hourly rate, minimum, and included services.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire Step 2 (Two Concerns question and layering), Step 3 (both promises), Step 5 (pricing framing elements like the pricing contrast and no-notes line), Step 6 (final concerns check), and Step 7 (rate lock, no deposit, and explicit ask for the business) — it treated this like a brief information call rather than a sales call, and ended without ever asking for the move.
